name: f2fp_e4m3_unpack_reuse
description: Same as f2fp_e4m3_unpack but the .H1 source operand carries the .reuse scheduling hint (R2.reuse.H1), as nvdisasm prints in CUTLASS ex94. Guards the operand-suffix-chain parse: BUG was suffix='reuse.H1' != 'H1' so UNPACK_B converted the LOW half. .reuse is semantics-free, so the host-computed expectations are unchanged.
